_comment: The situations engine (docs/PROACTIVE-MEMORY.md §4): every five minutes, no agent. moe-situations.py reads every consented source that offers the `items` connector verb since its cursor, gates each thread that moved, asks one small-model question of those that pass, and records what it finds in ~/.moe/proactive/situations.json and ~/.moe/logs/situations.jsonl. Silent in slice 2: stdout stays empty in every path, because a no_agent job's stdout IS a message to the person. configure-hermes.py (install_jobs) copies the script into $HERMES_HOME/scripts/ and registers this spec by name. Keys mirror cron.jobs.create_job().
_deliver: moe, so a failure Hermes reports about the job itself reaches Settings › Background as 'needs a look'. The script itself prints nothing.
name: moe-situations
